strings.en: A Trainer who visited recently told me{NEWLINE}about a Fire-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}It’s very loyal to its Trainer and loves{NEWLINE}to bark.{SCROLL}

strings.en: I’ve heard of a Pokémon with big, round{NEWLINE}eyes...{SCROLL}One that sings lullabies in a cute little{NEWLINE}voice!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不是有种非常有人气的精灵吗！{SCROLL}就是那个！黄色的身体、{NEWLINE}大红色的脸蛋的精灵！{SCROLL}真想看看它进化之前的样子啊。{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我在检查传送装置时发现{NEWLINE}有一种用长长的舌头舔的精灵{SCROLL}这么说来,它的膝盖上{CLEAR}还有个环状的标记！{SCROLL}
strings.en: While I was checking the transfer{NEWLINE}machine, I spotted a Pokémon that licks{CLEAR}with its long tongue.{SCROLL}Come to think of it, it had ring markings{NEWLINE}on its knees!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不是有种身上有红色球的{NEWLINE}海洋精灵吗？{CLEAR}长得像星星的形状。{SCROLL}听说一到晚上就出现,{NEWLINE}我真想看看啊~！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Do you know of a sea Pokémon that{NEWLINE}has a red sphere in its body?{CLEAR}You know, the one that’s shaped like{CLEAR}a star?{SCROLL}I heard that it appears at night.{NEWLINE}I would surely like to see it.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 听说有种有６根尾巴的{NEWLINE}可爱的精灵,{SCROLL}我也想抱一次那个精灵看看啊~{SCROLL}
strings.en: I heard about a cute Pokémon that{NEWLINE}has six tails.{SCROLL}I would love to hug a cute Pokémon{NEWLINE}like that.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 不是有种非常有人气的精灵吗！{SCROLL}就是那个！黄色的身体、{NEWLINE}大红色的脸蛋的精灵！{SCROLL}真想看看它进化之前的样子啊~{SCROLL}
strings.en: Isn’t there a really popular Pokémon?{NEWLINE}That one! The one with a yellow body{CLEAR}and bright red cheeks! I’d love to see{CLEAR}what it looks like before it evolves~{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你要是有那个精灵,{NEWLINE}能不能给我看看啊……{VAR:0200:0}{SCROLL}
strings.en: If you have that Pokémon, could you{NEWLINE}show it to me...?{VAR:0200:0}{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哦哦,愿意给我看吗！{NEWLINE}谢谢你啊！{SCROLL}
strings.en: You will show me?{NEWLINE}How good of you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 真遗憾啊……
strings.en: You don’t have it?{NEWLINE}That’s too bad...

strings.zh: 嗯……{SCROLL}我听说的精灵{NEWLINE}好像不是这个啊……
strings.en: Hm?{SCROLL}That’s not the Pokémon that I was{NEWLINE}told about...

strings.zh: 哦哦,这就是{VAR:0100:0}吗！{NEWLINE}真是漂亮的精灵啊！{SCROLL}为了感谢你给我看这么棒的东西{NEWLINE}这个送给你啦~！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Wow!{NEWLINE}That Pokémon is called {VAR:0100:0}!{SCROLL}It’s a wonderful Pokémon!{NEWLINE}As a token of my appreciation,{CLEAR}I would like to give this to you!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 再来玩啊~
strings.en: Come visit again{NEWLINE}sometime.

strings.zh: 谢谢你给我看了很多{NEWLINE}可爱的精灵啊。{CLEAR}我很开心呢。{SCROLL}咦呀~能跟你认识真是太棒了~
strings.en: Thanks for showing me so many cute{NEWLINE}Pokémon. I really enjoyed myself.{SCROLL}Oh my, I’m so glad I got to meet you!

strings.zh: 满是灰尘的机器上{NEWLINE}盖着布巾……{CLEAR}现在好像没在使用。
strings.en: There is a dusty machine under{NEWLINE}the cloth cover...{CLEAR}It has not been used for some time.

strings.zh: 小霞『天啊！{VAR:0100:0},{NEWLINE}这只小拉达会说人话！
strings.en: Misty: Oh my gosh! {VAR:0100:0}, this{NEWLINE}Rattata can talk!
strings.notes: #19–52: Bill turned into a Rattata by a virus in the Storage System (anime Kabuto nod); player and Misty go into cyberspace. #49 male / #50 female player.

strings.zh: 你好啊训练家,{NEWLINE}请先不要紧张和惊奇。{CLEAR}虽然听起来有点不可思议,{CLEAR}但是请你务必听我把话讲完。
strings.en: Hello there, Trainer. Please, don’t be{NEWLINE}alarmed.{SCROLL}I know this sounds hard to believe, but{NEWLINE}please hear me out.

strings.zh: 正辉『我是精灵装置发明家,{NEWLINE}我的名字叫正辉。{CLEAR}你们经常使用的口袋妖怪传送系统{CLEAR}就是我主导开发的。{SCROLL}正辉『我今天发现传送系统有问题{NEWLINE}就进到传送仓里进行维修,{CLEAR}结果传送装置突然开始运行,{CLEAR}居然把我变成了小拉达的样子！{SCROLL}正辉『根据我的分析,这应该是{NEWLINE}传送系统感染了电脑病毒所引起的。{CLEAR}因为传送系统可以将实体生物{CLEAR}转存到系统的存储空间里,{CLEAR}所以利用这一点,{CLEAR}就可以进入到传送系统内,{CLEAR}找出并消灭里面的病毒。
strings.en: Bill: I’m Bill, the Pokémon gadget{NEWLINE}inventor.{SCROLL}I led the development of the Pokémon{NEWLINE}Storage System you all use.{SCROLL}Bill: Today I found a fault in the{NEWLINE}transfer system and went into the{CLEAR}transfer pod to fix it.{SCROLL}Then the machine suddenly started up...{NEWLINE}and turned me into a Rattata!{SCROLL}Bill: By my analysis, the transfer{NEWLINE}system has caught a computer virus.{SCROLL}The system can store living things in its{NEWLINE}memory space.{SCROLL}So someone could use that to go inside{NEWLINE}and wipe out the virus.

strings.zh: 正辉『我现在是小拉达的样子,{NEWLINE}能做的事情很有限,{CLEAR}如果你们愿意进入传送系统{CLEAR}帮我把病毒清除掉的话,{CLEAR}那就太好了。{SCROLL}是否帮正辉清除病毒？
strings.en: Bill: As a Rattata, there’s not much I{NEWLINE}can do.{SCROLL}If you’d go into the transfer system{NEWLINE}and clear out the virus for me, that{CLEAR}would be wonderful.{SCROLL}Help Bill get rid of the virus?

strings.zh: 正辉『不肯帮忙吗？{NEWLINE}唉……这可怎么办。
strings.en: Bill: You won’t help? Oh... What am I{NEWLINE}going to do?

strings.zh: 正辉『这么说二位都愿意帮忙啦？{NEWLINE}真是太谢谢你们了！{CLEAR}话说还没请教二位的名字呢……
strings.en: Bill: So you’ll both help? Thank you so{NEWLINE}much!{SCROLL}Oh, I haven’t asked your names yet...

strings.zh: 正辉『好的,{VAR:0103:0}、小霞。{NEWLINE}现在请你进到右侧的传送仓里,{CLEAR}我会按下传送按钮{CLEAR}把你传送到系统内部,{CLEAR}你进去之后按照我的指示{CLEAR}把病毒消灭掉就可以了。
strings.en: Bill: All right, {VAR:0103:0} and Misty.{SCROLL}Please step into the transfer pod on{NEWLINE}the right.{SCROLL}I’ll press the transfer button and send{NEWLINE}you into the system.{SCROLL}Once you’re inside, just follow my{NEWLINE}instructions and wipe out the virus.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我是来自真新镇的{VAR:0103:0}。{NEWLINE}这位是华蓝道馆的小霞。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m {VAR:0103:0} from Pallet Town.{NEWLINE}And this is Misty from the Cerulean Gym.

strings.zh: 小霞『{VAR:0103:0},这可是进入电脑空间啊！{NEWLINE}听起来就很危险的样子……{CLEAR}不过你执意要去的话,{CLEAR}那我可不能丢下你不管。
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}, we’d be going into{NEWLINE}cyberspace!{SCROLL}That sounds really dangerous...{SCROLL}But if you’re set on going, I can’t just{NEWLINE}leave you on your own.

strings.zh: 正辉『如果二位都肯帮忙的话,{NEWLINE}那真是再好不过了！{CLEAR}那么请二位站到右侧的传送仓前吧,{CLEAR}我去启动传送程序。
strings.en: Bill: If you’ll both help, that’s better{NEWLINE}than I could hope for!{SCROLL}Please stand in front of the pod on the{NEWLINE}right. I’ll start the transfer program.

strings.zh: 小霞『这听起来很危险的样子,{NEWLINE}不过{VAR:0103:0}都这么奋不顾身的话,{CLEAR}那我也不能落后呀。{CLEAR}让我陪你一起去吧。
strings.en: Misty: This sounds really dangerous...{SCROLL}But if {VAR:0103:0} is throwing caution to{NEWLINE}the wind, I can’t fall behind!{SCROLL}Let me go with you.

strings.zh: 正辉『那么请两位做好准备,{NEWLINE}现在传送开始！
strings.en: Bill: Get ready, you two. Starting the{NEWLINE}transfer now!

strings.zh: 正辉『{VAR:0103:0}、小霞,{NEWLINE}你们现在应该能够听到我的声音。{CLEAR}在这个系统空间的四个角落里,{CLEAR}有四个口袋妖怪外形的电脑病毒,{CLEAR}找出并打败它们的话,{CLEAR}系统就会恢复正常。拜托你们了！
strings.en: Bill: {VAR:0103:0}, Misty, you should be able{NEWLINE}to hear me now.{SCROLL}In the four corners of this system{NEWLINE}space, there are four computer viruses{CLEAR}shaped like Pokémon.{SCROLL}Find them and beat them, and the system{NEWLINE}will go back to normal.{SCROLL}I’m counting on you!

strings.zh: 小霞『{VAR:0103:0}咱们分头行动,{NEWLINE}快点把病毒给解决掉吧。
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}, let’s split up and take{NEWLINE}care of these viruses fast.

strings.zh: 黑鲁加『Houndoo——！
strings.en: Houndoom: Houndoo-!

strings.zh: 正辉『{VAR:0103:0}、小霞！{NEWLINE}大事不好了,{CLEAR}你们刚刚打败的精灵{CLEAR}不是病毒的本体,{CLEAR}病毒的本体现在正在电脑空间的中心{CLEAR}破坏系统空间的出入口,{CLEAR}你们现在快赶回空间中心{CLEAR}去击败病毒本体,{CLEAR}晚了就来不及了！
strings.en: Bill: {VAR:0103:0}, Misty! We’ve got trouble!{SCROLL}The Pokémon you just beat weren’t the{NEWLINE}virus itself.{SCROLL}The real virus is in the center of{NEWLINE}cyberspace, destroying the system’s{CLEAR}entrance and exit!{SCROLL}Hurry back to the center and defeat it{NEWLINE}before it’s too late!

strings.zh: 龙王蝎『Drapioooo——！
strings.en: Drapion: Drapioooo-!

strings.zh: 吸盘魔偶『Bar——ri！
strings.en: Mr. Mime: Bar-ri!

strings.zh: 小霞『这个电脑病毒还挺厉害的！{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0},咱们一起上！
strings.en: Misty: This computer virus is pretty{NEWLINE}tough!{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, let’s take it on together!

strings.zh: 正辉『太棒了！{VAR:0103:0}、小霞！{NEWLINE}你们成功把电脑病毒给击退了。{CLEAR}站在那里不要动,{CLEAR}我现在把你们传送回现实世界。
strings.en: Bill: Fantastic! {VAR:0103:0}, Misty! You{NEWLINE}drove off the computer virus!{SCROLL}Stay right where you are. I’ll send you{NEWLINE}back to the real world now.

strings.zh: 正辉『辛苦你们了,{VAR:0103:0}、小霞。{NEWLINE}我现在要进入到传送系统{CLEAR}好恢复自己的身体。{CLEAR}麻烦{VAR:0103:0}帮我按一下启动按钮,{CLEAR}就是红色那个按钮,很明显的。
strings.en: Bill: Great work, {VAR:0103:0} and Misty.{SCROLL}Now I need to go into the transfer{NEWLINE}system to get my body back.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, could you press the start{NEWLINE}button for me? It’s the red one.{SCROLL}You can’t miss it.

strings.zh: 正辉『哈哈！太棒了！{NEWLINE}还是人类的身体好啊！。
strings.en: Bill: Ha ha! Fantastic! Nothing beats a{NEWLINE}human body!

strings.zh: 正辉『这次真是多亏了{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}和小霞。{CLEAR}不然真的很难估量这电脑病毒{CLEAR}到底会造成多大的损失。{CLEAR}话说这种恶意破坏系统的病毒{CLEAR}到底是什么人做的呢……
strings.en: Bill: This time I really owe {VAR:0103:0} and{NEWLINE}Misty.{SCROLL}Who knows how much damage that virus{NEWLINE}could have done otherwise.{SCROLL}But who would make a virus that{NEWLINE}maliciously wrecks the system...

strings.zh: 正辉『算了,幕后黑手的事{NEWLINE}以后再说吧。{CLEAR}作为感谢,我这里有几张{CLEAR}圣安努号豪华游轮的度假船票,{CLEAR}送给你们以表我的谢意吧。
strings.en: Bill: Oh well, we can worry about{NEWLINE}whoever’s behind it later.{SCROLL}As thanks, I have some tickets for a{NEWLINE}cruise on the luxury liner S.S. Anne.{SCROLL}Please take them!

strings.zh: 小霞『经过了这么多事情之后,{NEWLINE}我更加佩服{VAR:0103:0}的勇气和实力了。{CLEAR}现在我就回华蓝道馆,{CLEAR}随时欢迎{VAR:0103:0}来挑战。
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}, after all this, I admire{NEWLINE}your courage and strength even more.{SCROLL}I’m heading back to the Gym. Come{NEWLINE}challenge me anytime, {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: 小霞『这里交给我就行了,{VAR:0103:0}。{NEWLINE}你去清除其他的病毒吧！
strings.en: Misty: Leave this one to me, {VAR:0103:0}.{NEWLINE}You go clear out the other viruses!

strings.zh: 小霞『这个电脑病毒还挺厉害的！{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0},你从旁边夹击它！
strings.en: Misty: This computer virus is pretty{NEWLINE}tough! {VAR:0103:0}, hit it from the side!

strings.zh: 宝石海星『Star——mee！
strings.en: Starmie: Star-mee!

strings.zh: 念力土偶『Cla——doooo！
strings.en: Claydol: Cla-doooo!

strings.zh: 正辉『多亏你们的帮忙,{NEWLINE}现在电脑病毒已经被清除干净了。
strings.en: Bill: Thanks to your help, the computer{NEWLINE}virus has been wiped out completely.

strings.zh: 小霞『谢礼什么的我就不要了,{NEWLINE}你还是给{VAR:0103:0}吧。{CLEAR}他在旅行中应该用得到。
strings.en: Misty: I don’t need a reward or{NEWLINE}anything. Give it to {VAR:0103:0} instead.{SCROLL}He’ll need it on his journey.

strings.zh: 小霞『谢礼什么的我就不要了,{NEWLINE}你还是给{VAR:0103:0}吧。{CLEAR}她在旅行中应该用得到。
strings.en: Misty: I don’t need a reward or{NEWLINE}anything. Give it to {VAR:0103:0} instead.{SCROLL}She’ll need it on her journey.

strings.zh: 正辉『这是我的电话号码,{NEWLINE}你们记一下吧,{CLEAR}或许以后用得到。
strings.en: Bill: Here’s my phone number. Take it{NEWLINE}down. It might come in handy someday.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}在手机上{NEWLINE}登录了正辉！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} registered Bill’s number in the{NEWLINE}Pokégear!
